dedupe_keys.name: hong kong 2021 population census key statistics by district council district constituency area tertiary planning unit group and street block group

description: The Census and Statistics Department of Hong Kong publishes key statistics from the 2021 Population Census as downloadable tables for several small-area geographies: District Council districts and constituency areas, large and small tertiary planning unit groups, large and small street block groups, and major housing estates. Each file has about 200 columns per area, covering population by sex, age, ethnicity and education, the working population by place of work (same district or elsewhere), industry, occupation and hours, and housing: occupied quarters, domestic households and population by type of housing, rent, rent-to-income ratio and median floor area of accommodation. An online service lets users build their own tables. Coverage: all of Hong Kong. Format and access: Excel and zipped CSV files free without registration on the census website. Licence: not stated on the census download pages. Caveats: the finest areas are groups of street blocks and planning units, not single blocks, the tables are wide with bilingual headers in several rows, and there are no boundaries in the download (the website map uses a separate viewer, census.centamap.com). Simulation uses: population and housing exposure by small area for typhoon, flooding and landslide studies, and working-population location for transport demand. Related records: WorldPop and GHSL population grids and the China census yearbook.
